war_summary: On Day 101 of War 139, heavy combat and rapid base turnover are concentrated across coastal and central frontlines. Endless Shore and Oarbreaker remain the primary flashpoints with high casualty rates and continuous back-and-forth base captures, while Godcrofts and Stlican Shelf are experiencing active recent base contested status and flips. Simultaneously, massive casualty surges and accelerated enlistments in central mainland corridors such as Callahan's Passage, Marban Hollow, and Clahstra indicate large-scale offensives and fierce defensive stands along key strategic borders.
